samples.title: Cable families: Proof strip
samples.statement:
Your task
Build a result list using Step 1. Then use that list to find the answer in Step 2.

Inputs
links is a square table of 0s and 1s. Points are numbered from 0. A 1 at links[a][b] joins points a and b in both directions. A 0 means no link. k is included in the function call, but this task does not use it. You can ignore it.

Step 1: Build the result list
This graph has two-way links between points. Points belong to the same group if you can travel between them, even through other points. Use union-find: start with one group per point, then join groups when a link connects them. For each point, count all points in its group, including itself. Record these counts in point order. A link from a point to itself does not make a larger group. A graph with no points gives an empty result list.

Step 2: Return the answer
Return the whole result list in the order you built it. If it is empty, return [].

Write your function
Complete cableFamiliesProofStrip(links, k). Return the answer from Step 2. Do not print it or read keyboard input. In examples, positions (indexes) start at 0 unless a rule says otherwise.
